notes.title: Update 0.1.0 !
notes.content:
[h1]The 0.1.0 update is here ![/h1]
[h2]It's been an entire year since the derpies invaded steam, and to celebrate that, we changed everything ![/h2]

[h2]What's this update about ?[/h2]

[h3]The game already has a changlog inside, but we're gonna detail it here :[/h3]

[list]
[*] Better Optimization, the game is now smoother, which led us to add a ton of new animations, and new lighting effects

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30812571/d0d010ae9d91f0e88745a1722edc1158a75a7e2d.png[/img]

[*] The derpies' physics has been redone, when a derpy dies, it explodes in pieces ! And those pieces react with their environment, like for example an explosion, or a player's dash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30812571/f4b29617bcb42966a6a07651af1efc0600d5a550.png[/img]

[*] Linking your controller and keyboard controls are now automatic. Before, you needed to click on things, now, you just need to press a button. If you press a button on a wrong controller, don't worry, simply pass your mouse over it, and click to delete the controller.
Remember : Player 1 can use the keyboard with ZQSD or a controller (if you have a qwerty keyboard, simply change your keyboard in your computer settings to French)
, Player 2 can use directionnal arrows or a controller, and player 3/4 can only play with a controller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30812571/f9ca0c540e8650da790c84145734cc67ee176e64.png[/img]

[i](The max controllers linked to the game is 4, if you plugged more than 4 controllers on your PC, it's possible that the game doesn't recognize the new ones, to avoid that, simply reset your game controllers in your computer settings)[/i]

[*] Better visibility when a derpy dies. It was pretty difficult to see who won at the end of a round, we made the camera slower, so it takes a little more time to zoom, letting you have a better understanding of who's the winner.
But that's not all ! We added some stripes around the screen that change colors depending on the derpy killed, so keep a eye on it, to determine who won.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30812571/b7a75f10e479f7b5b51d0247f783f6bc88db7433.png[/img]

[*] The round is displayed at the start of every... round... [strike]yeah logic[/strike]
It'll be easier to know how far into the game you are.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30812571/062deabcdea1a108411f4f1a21d70288d20b931c.png[/img]

[*] Fullscreen should work without creating visual bugs.

[*] The glitch where to menu music would start, then stop, before starting again has been fixed.

[*] The visual effects option now influence the blood. It'll be less detailed but the game will run smoother.

[*]A new option window has been added ! It has language and volume, to access it, go to options et press left or right. To change to volume or the language, press X (controller) ou E (keyboard)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30812571/a7554b0e862c5b4229877968c0d82a49e8367421.png[/img]

[*] Graphics were entirely remade ! Indeed, with the new lighting effects, we added some black outlines around each element of the game. Now it's more cartoon, and the player and platforms are now more visible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30812571/06018680e2fa59eb517fc464bbb7cef2d9b49955.png[/img]

[*]And to finish off, the Candyland map has been changed ! Now it's sweetland !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30812571/1177db82c6c6dfa603117476da191bfa41c54bf2.png[/img]

[strike][i](we can see Néonville far in the distance, that's cool)[/i][/strike]
[/list]

There, that's all for update 0.1.0 !
We hope you'll like the new update as much as we do, we sure had fun working on it !
Thanks everyone for your support during one year, and it's only the beginning ;)

Don't forget to report any bugs, or if you have any suggestion for the future of the game ^^

[h3]Keep brawling ;)[/h3]
